# Angola (AGO) — sub-national homicide

## Found
- INE "Anuário de Estatísticas Sociais" Quadro 2.11 gives police-recorded crimes by province by type, with a column "Homicídios voluntários" (voluntary homicides). Years available: 2015, 2016 (edition 2022, yearbook 2015-2019) and 2020, 2021 (yearbook 2017-2022). 18 provinces (pre-2024 division) plus the national row. All extracted to rows.csv, together with the "Total" crimes column for context.
- Original compiler is the Ministério do Interior (Polícia Nacional); INE reproduces its tables.

## Gaps / problems
- No homicide-by-province figures for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022 or later in any INE yearbook found. The 2017-2022 yearbook only prints 2020-2021 for this table.
- Figures are counts only; no rates published. Province populations are in Quadro 2.2 of the same yearbooks if the owner wants to compute rates.
- Angola created new provinces in 2024 (Icolo e Bengo, Moxico Leste, Cuando, Cubango); all figures here use the old 18-province set.
- 2016 national total "43 545" is printed on a separate line in the PDF; extracted manually from the page text (not fabricated).
- The 2015 table cites "Relatório Síntese de Segurança Pública, 2013-2016" and the 2020-21 table cites "Relatório das Actividades Desenvolvidas 2020-2021" of the Ministério do Interior; those underlying police reports were not found online.
- The Ministério da Saúde "Anuário Estatístico Sanitário 2023" (https://www.ine.gov.ao/Arquivos/arquivosCarregados/Carregados/Publicacao_639110352357683245.pdf) was checked: its causes-of-death table (Tabela 36) does not list assault/homicide, so no health-statistics figures.
- Licence: none stated; colophon says "Copyright: INE".

## Other content in the sources
- Quadro 2.10: crimes registered, cleared, detained (and convicted/acquitted in the 2015-16 edition) by province.
- Quadro 2.12-2.13: road-accident deaths by province.
